models.name: discussion_board_file_scans
models.description: Security scanning results and audit trail for file uploads. Records virus scan outcomes, security assessments, and scanning history to ensure uploaded files meet platform security standards.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_file_upload_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the file upload record. {@link discussion_board_file_uploads.id}

plainFields.name: scan_engine
plainFields.description: Name of the antivirus/security scanning engine used.

plainFields.name: scan_version
plainFields.description: Version of the scanning engine.

plainFields.name: scan_result
plainFields.description: Result of the security scan (clean, infected, suspicious, error).

plainFields.name: threat_name
plainFields.description: Name of detected threat if file is infected.

plainFields.name: threat_type
plainFields.description: Type of security threat detected.

plainFields.name: scan_duration
plainFields.description: Duration of scan in milliseconds.

plainFields.name: file_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the file content for integrity verification.

plainFields.name: scan_timestamp
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the scan was performed.

plainFields.name: is_quarantined
plainFields.description: Whether the file was quarantined due to security concerns.

plainFields.name: quarantine_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for quarantine if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the scan record was created.

models.name: discussion_board_search_index
models.description: Search index for efficient content discovery and retrieval. Contains pre-processed search terms from posts and comments to enable fast text-based searching across the discussion board. Maintains search relevance scores and term frequency data for ranking search results.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the indexed post. {@link discussion_board_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the indexed comment. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: search_terms
plainFields.description: Pre-processed search terms extracted from content for efficient searching.

plainFields.name: relevance_score
plainFields.description: Calculated relevance score for search result ranking.

plainFields.name: term_frequency
plainFields.description: Frequency of search terms within the content for ranking purposes.

plainFields.name: last_indexed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this search index entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this search index entry was created.

models.name: discussion_board_trending_content
models.description: Tracks trending posts and comments based on recent engagement metrics. Used to surface popular content to users and identify discussions gaining momentum. Updated periodically based on view counts, comment activity, and engagement patterns.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the trending post. {@link discussion_board_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the trending comment. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: trend_score
plainFields.description: Calculated trend score based on engagement metrics and recency.

plainFields.name: engagement_count
plainFields.description: Total engagement count including views, comments, and interactions.

plainFields.name: trend_period
plainFields.description: Time period for which this trend is calculated (e.g., '24h', '7d').

plainFields.name: calculated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this trend calculation was performed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this trend record was created.

models.name: discussion_board_user_following
models.description: Tracks user following relationships for personalized content discovery. Allows users to follow other members and receive prioritized content from followed users in their discovery feeds.

foreignFields.name: follower_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who is following. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: followed_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member being followed. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: notifications_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether the follower wants to receive notifications for followed user's activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this following relationship was established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this following relationship was last updated.

models.name: discussion_board_content_views
models.description: Tracks content view counts for discovery and analytics purposes. Records individual views of posts and comments to measure engagement and popularity for content discovery features.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the viewed post. {@link discussion_board_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the viewed comment. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: viewer_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who viewed the content. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: view_count
plainFields.description: Incremental view count for aggregation purposes.

plainFields.name: viewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the content was viewed.

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Session identifier for tracking view sessions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this view record was created.

models.name: discussion_board_platform_metrics
models.description: Enhanced daily snapshots of platform-wide metrics with improved indexing and data integrity. Tracks overall system health, user growth, content creation rates, and engagement patterns over time with optimized query performance for business intelligence and capacity planning.

plainFields.name: metric_date
plainFields.description: Date for which the metrics snapshot was recorded. Used for time-series analysis and trend tracking.

plainFields.name: total_users
plainFields.description: Total number of registered users on the platform as of the metric date.

plainFields.name: active_users
plainFields.description: Number of users who were active during the metric period (logged in or performed actions).

plainFields.name: new_posts
plainFields.description: Number of new discussion posts created during the metric period.

plainFields.name: total_posts
plainFields.description: Total number of posts available on the platform as of the metric date.

plainFields.name: new_comments
plainFields.description: Number of new comments added during the metric period.

plainFields.name: total_comments
plainFields.description: Total number of comments available on the platform as of the metric date.

plainFields.name: page_views
plainFields.description: Total number of page views recorded during the metric period.

plainFields.name: attachment_uploads
plainFields.description: Number of file attachments uploaded during the metric period.

plainFields.name: report_count
plainFields.description: Number of content reports submitted during the metric period.

plainFields.name: avg_response_time
plainFields.description: Average system response time in milliseconds for user interactions during the period.

plainFields.name: uptime_percentage
plainFields.description: Platform uptime percentage for the metric period, calculated from monitoring data.

plainFields.name: error_rate
plainFields.description: System error rate percentage for the metric period.

plainFields.name: user_satisfaction_score
plainFields.description: Aggregated user satisfaction score based on feedback and engagement patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this metric snapshot was recorded and stored.

models.name: discussion_board_user_engagement
models.description: Enhanced tracking of individual user engagement patterns with proper referential integrity. Captures user-level statistics including session duration, content creation frequency, interaction patterns, and platform usage intensity with optimized performance for user retention analysis.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific member whose engagement is being tracked. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: tracking_date
plainFields.description: Date for which the user engagement metrics are recorded and analyzed.

plainFields.name: session_count
plainFields.description: Number of user sessions initiated during the tracking period.

plainFields.name: session_duration
plainFields.description: Total time spent on platform in seconds across all sessions during the period.

plainFields.name: posts_created
plainFields.description: Number of discussion posts created by the user during the tracking period.

plainFields.name: comments_made
plainFields.description: Number of comments posted by the user during the tracking period.

plainFields.name: content_viewed
plainFields.description: Number of posts and comments viewed by the user during the period.

plainFields.name: attachments_uploaded
plainFields.description: Number of file attachments uploaded by the user during the period.

plainFields.name: reports_submitted
plainFields.description: Number of content reports submitted by the user during the period.

plainFields.name: follows_added
plainFields.description: Number of new users followed by the member during the tracking period.

plainFields.name: saved_content
plainFields.description: Number of posts or comments saved/bookmarked by the user during the period.

plainFields.name: engagement_score
plainFields.description: Calculated engagement score based on weighted activity metrics for the period.

plainFields.name: retention_indicator
plainFields.description: Indicator of whether the user is likely to return based on engagement patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this engagement record was created and stored.

models.name: discussion_board_performance_logs
models.description: Enhanced performance logging with proper data typing and optimized indexing. Records technical performance metrics, system errors, and operational data for platform optimization and reliability monitoring with improved query performance for troubleshooting and analysis.

plainFields.name: log_timestamp
plainFields.description: Precise timestamp when the performance event or metric was recorded.

plainFields.name: metric_type
plainFields.description: Type of performance metric being logged (response_time, error_rate, cpu_usage, memory_usage, database_queries, cache_hit_rate).

plainFields.name: metric_value
plainFields.description: Numeric value of the performance metric recorded at the specified timestamp.

plainFields.name: endpoint
plainFields.description: Specific API endpoint or page that generated the performance metric, if applicable.

plainFields.name: http_status
plainFields.description: HTTP status code associated with the performance event, for error tracking.

plainFields.name: response_time
plainFields.description: Response time in milliseconds for the recorded transaction or request.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string from the client making the request, for performance analysis.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the client for geographic performance analysis and troubleshooting.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Error message or exception details if the log entry represents an error condition.

plainFields.name: server_id
plainFields.description: Identifier for the server instance that recorded the performance metric.

plainFields.name: severity_level
plainFields.description: Severity level of the performance event (info, warning, error, critical).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this performance log entry was stored in the database.
